meta_title: Party sweets: cupcakes, cake pops, cakesicles | Gateaux Patience
meta_desc: Handmade cupcakes, cake pops, cakesicles and desserts in Sidi Bel Abbès, in your colors and matched to your cake. Order on WhatsApp.

hero.title: Sweets for the party.
hero.lead: Handmade cupcakes, cake pops and cakesicles from Sidi Bel Abbès: in your colors, in your theme, even spelling a name letter by letter.
hero.photo_alt: Pink cakesicles bearing the letters K, E, N, Z and A, chocolate cakesicles and 2020 graduation cake pops
hero.caption: A real order: cakesicles that spell a name, and cake pops wearing graduation caps.
hero.note: Tell us the date, the number of guests and the theme, and we’ll reply on WhatsApp.

menu.title: The sweets menu
menu.intro: Pick a sweet: your WhatsApp message is already written, just add the date and the number of guests.

cupcakes.name: Cupcakes
cupcakes.text: A soft little cake topped with frosting, decorated in your theme: characters, flowers or the party colors.
cupcakes.for: For a birthday party, a new baby or a wedding table.

cake_pops.name: Cake pops
cake_pops.text: A bite of cake on a stick, dipped in chocolate and decorated one by one.
cake_pops.for: For guest favors, a birthday or a success to celebrate.

cakesicles.name: Cakesicles
cakesicles.text: A cake popsicle dipped in chocolate, which can carry a letter, a number or a small decoration.
cakesicles.for: To spell a name letter by letter, for a graduation or an engagement.

desserts.name: Desserts
desserts.text: Party desserts to share, prepared for your table and your guests.
desserts.for: To round out a buffet, an engagement or a wedding.

menu.other: Something else in mind? Send us a photo or an idea and we’ll tell you what we can make.
